reserveReview.rationale: The October 15 dashboard and its embedded asset_classes payload supersede the October 8 snapshot. The five exact source percentages total 100%; displayed two-decimal labels total 99.99% and are not normalized. Gross category values sum to USD 65,491,180.51503999. The payload separately marks USD 29,448,666.93235196, or 44.96585143336835% of the whole book, across 437 liquid-hedge assets as unclassified. Category examples do not establish all constituent identities, obligors or tracked dependencies. Accountable separately reports USD 65,744,482.26 gross reserves and USD 65,377,351.98 supply, including USD 12.41 legacy Plasma units; its reserve clock and proof fields differ from the issuer snapshot. No cross-clock ratio, V2-only reserve allocation or independently validated cryptographic or financial assurance is inferred. Manual-review confidence and the open canonical reserve-composition gap are retained.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The deposit address is an entry point, not a whole-book custodian. Docs say no current off-exchange custody, while the October 15 dashboard assigns 2.08% to qualified custody and 0.98% to onchain derivatives margin. The dashboard calls location ratios working management classifications pending Finance and Risk validation. This contradiction remains unresolved, so custodyModel stays unknown rather than a whole-book CEX or institutional tier. Location percentages are not named-provider shares or legal segregation evidence; no share is assigned to the deposit address or a guessed venue.
